# Glowré

> Glowré is a Malaysian shower oil brand. Glowré Shower Oil (500 ml) is a golden sweet almond oil that turns into a light milky lather when it meets water, then rinses clean and leaves skin soft. Sold online at https://glowreskin.online with delivery across Malaysia.

## Products and prices (MYR)
- Glowré Shower Oil 500 ml: RM89, comes with 1 free gift (striped towel, charcoal towel or 20 ml travel pouch)
- Two bottles (2 × 500 ml): RM168, comes with 2 free gifts
- Striped coral fleece towel 35 × 75 cm: RM8
- Charcoal (bamboo charcoal) towel 35 × 75 cm: RM8
- Travel pouch 20 ml: RM5; three pouches: RM12

## Shipping
- Shower oil orders ship free in Malaysia.
- Otherwise West Malaysia RM6 (free from RM20); Sabah, Sarawak, Labuan RM15 (free from RM50).
- Ships within 1–2 working days; tracking number sent on WhatsApp.

## How to order
- Order on https://glowreskin.online ("Order now"), verify a WhatsApp number, pay by online banking or card (ToyyibPay).

## Product facts
- Key oils: sweet almond, grape seed, sunflower, vitamin E. Scent: warm sweet almond with a little bergamot.
- Use: 2–3 pumps on wet skin, massage into a milky lather, rinse.
- Contains fragrance and a nut-derived oil; patch test if sensitive. External use only; keep away from eyes.
- Full ingredients: Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, TIPA-Laureth Sulfate, Laureth-3, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Parfum, Cocamide MEA, Propylene Glycol, Sorbitan Oleate, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Aqua, Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract, Limonene, Coumarin, Linalool.
